### Machine vision

| Scenario | Method | Result | Key metrics |
|---|---|---|---|
| Orchard — stereo camera (ZED X): YOLO detection + ByteTrack + 3D positions | `yolov8s + bytetrack + depth_centroid` | **pass** | precision 99 % ✓<br>recall (objects ≥ 10 px) 71 % ✓<br>3D position error 24 mm ✓<br>tracked ids in last frame 39 ✓<br>targets created 39 pairs ✓ |

<details><summary><code>vis_vla_approach</code> — VLA — "pick the apple": policy actions move the eye-in-hand camera to the fruit</summary>

Each step the image + instruction go to the policy; the returned 7-DoF action is applied as a TCP delta (20 mm / 5° per step) until the policy signals the grasp.

*How to reproduce:* Camera on a tool → wizard task VLA policy → Runtime: VLA URL / format openpi → Vision tab: instruction → Ask / step repeatedly (or live).

| Metric | Value | Criterion |
|---|---|---|
| start distance to nearest apple | 400 mm |   |
| steps | 21 |   |
| grasp signalled | yes | yes within 80 steps ✓ |
| final distance to apple | 143 mm | < 200 mm ✓ |

</details>
